blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore the intact map's playable A/B/C combat-motion route, externalize viewmodel adaptation, and repair locomotion audio plus daylight without regressing clean boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: A route-topology blocker prevents continuous regional animation evidence. Viewmodel work also patched the coupled component instead of adapting it externally. Separately, footstep playback/mix and the centralized daylight profile remain defective.

stop_conditions: Do not alter authored map children or imported viewmodel meshes, bones, skeletons, clips, or package composition.
Do not replace preserved map or viewmodel packages without explicit Tester package-incompatibility evidence.
Do not claim audio success without audible mixed-output evidence; Tester owns issue closure.

strategy.rationale: Use direct topology restoration and external adapter isolation instead of further transform tuning. Fix audio and lighting only at their existing owners.

code: Verify clean import/boot, intact component restoration, unchanged imported assets/map children, route legality, animation binding, audio-owner count, and no placeholder generators.
Check checkpoint/Replay cleanup, recoil baseline recovery, shot-ID deduplication, and late callback errors.
runtime: Tester traverses A/B/C in advancing gameplay time and samples route budgets, roster occupancy, occlusion, animation states, viewmodel actions, restore, Replay, and victory.
Tester audits idle/walk/sprint audio and mixed output, then patrols mouse look, movement, R/F6 separation, recoil return, HUD events, and near/mid/long reticle-ballistic agreement.
visual: Capture matched spawn/A/B/C actor views and hip/ADS/fire/reload viewmodel frames showing grounding, upright motion, hand contact, sockets, and no clipping.
Capture matched lit/shaded route views and HUD at 100% plus 200% stress, restoring 100%; preserve material detail, atmosphere layers, safe areas, and event readability.

done_when: One intact authored map remains; product-owned datum, collision, navigation, spawn, and objective anchors permit ordered spawn→A→B→C traversal within PRD route budgets.
The 3/5/10 roster has stable identities, clear supported capsules, actor separation, reciprocal wall occlusion, and upright roots through spawn, combat, restore, and Replay.
Enemy velocity, visibility, ammo, damage, and death authority drive rifle-compatible move/aim/fire/reload/hurt/death animation without sliding or pistol semantics.

The AK-74M component is restored intact; external product code binds both weapons' hip, ADS, fire/recovery, reload, dry-fire, inspect, switch, sockets, bounds, hand contact, reset, and victory motion.
tasks.instructions: Preserve the authored environment singleton and repair only its product-owned outer datum, collision/navigation, boundaries, spawn, objectives, and route chains. Remove conflicting proxy support without touching imported children. Bind enemy presentation to authoritative combat facts and keep navigation roots upright. Restore the registered AK-74M internal file, move adaptation and telemetry into product-owned weapon code, and calibrate each coupled viewmodel only at its adapter/profile root.
tasks.title: Restore combat motion and route

done_when: The retained viewmodel is the sole player-footstep owner, each enemy has one emitter, and long recordings never restart at per-step cadence.
Walk, sprint, crouch, landing, and enemy movement produce audible cadence-compatible concrete/metal Foley without duplicate owners, buzz, hum, or synthesized placeholders.
Audio state identifies active streams, duration, gain, pitch, attenuation, bus stages, competing audio, effective listener gain, and lifecycle cleanup.
Matched gameplay views preserve sunlit material detail and readable shadows while retaining sky, shadows, SSAO, both cloud variants, flare, native materials, and the intact map.
tasks.instructions: Trace retained WalkAudio/RunAudio, every emitter, observer, bus, and audible generated stream. Preserve current ownership; fix transition playback, gain, and masking, or atomically replace unsuitable sources with inspected contact samples. Add required locomotion/surface distinctions without oscillators. Calibrate exposure and light energy only through ArenaFoundation and preserve every accepted atmosphere layer.
